name: applemail-relay
description: InboxPip connects selected inboxes to your agent for email briefings and reply drafts.

interface.shortDescription: Brief your inbox. Draft the reply.
interface.longDescription: Read selected email accounts, find messages and prepare reply drafts. Each connection is restricted to the accounts and permissions you approve. Uses an existing InboxPip account.
defaultPrompt: Summarize unread mail in my work inbox without changing anything.
Find the receipt I need in my personal inbox.
Draft a reply to the message I choose and show me before sending.
